project_title: Global Supply Chain Bottleneck & Dwell Time Forecasting

squad_roles_delivered.Role 01: Data Engineer: Telemetry Resampling, Graph Adjacency, and 12h Sliding Window Datasets (2,700 train / 923 test).
squad_roles_delivered.Role 02: EDA Engineer: Dwell Waveform Analysis, Cross-Feature Correlations, and 1-12h Autocorrelation Profiling.
squad_roles_delivered.Role 03: DL Engineer: PyTorch LSTM Architecture (5,921 params), 35-Epoch Training Loop, and Graph Spatial Ablation Study.
squad_roles_delivered.Role 04: Evaluation Engineer: Unseen Test Benchmark Verification (MAE: 4.28h, RMSE: 5.70h, R²: 0.602, Precision: 96.5%).
squad_roles_delivered.Role 05: Integration Engineer: Hardened predict_next_dwell_hours() API with live triage advisories across all 6 logistics hubs.
